readme.tagline: Write the sounds of one language in another script.
readme.opening: Write Japanese **猫** as **네코** in Hangul, or Korean **안녕하세요** as **アンニョンハセヨ** in katakana. The converter reads the source into International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) and respells it using the target language’s conventions.
readme.browser: Paste this into an HTML page. The jsDelivr URL is pinned to a source commit and requires no API key.
readme.name: Function
readme.one: Pronunciation spelling in the selected target language
readme.all: IPA and 24 target spellings in outputs
readme.transcript: IPA, source segments, unresolved items and diagnostics
readme.languageList: Supported language IDs, display names, scripts and variants
readme.options: Use different language IDs for source and target. The default mode is 'text'. Use 'ipa' for direct IPA input.
readme.variants: Use variant to select a source variety, such as 'US' or 'UK' for English. See languages for the available variants.
readme.numbers: Set readNumbers to true to read supported integers as cardinal numbers in the source language.
readme.diagnosis: The ipa field preserves phrase and language boundaries and line breaks. The segments field contains source spans and their languages. Matched IPA delimiters have delimiter: true.
readme.detail: Unresolved readings appear as □ and are listed in unresolved. The fields unknownPhones, unpairedDelimiters and unavailableSources report unsupported IPA, unmatched delimiters and missing reading resources. Korean romanization appears in romanization.
readme.selfhost: Requires Node.js 22 or later. Keep dist/ and assets/ in the same relative locations when self-hosting. Conversion runs in the browser and fetches dictionaries and engine files on first use.
readme.limits: Tones, stress and sounds may be approximated or omitted depending on what the target script can represent.
readme.origin: This project starts from IPA-Translator. The code is GPL-3.0 and bundled dictionaries and models retain their own licenses.
readme.coverage: 25 source languages · 600 conversion directions · Browser ES module
